package.name: tf2_standalone
package.description:
Standalone wrapper around tf2::BufferCore with a ROS-agnostic API.
This library provides coordinate transform capabilities without requiring ROS headers or libraries at runtime. The public API uses only: - tf2::Transform, tf2::Quaternion, tf2::Vector3 (from tf2_types) - tf2::TimePoint, tf2::Duration (std::chrono based, from tf2_types) - std::string for frame IDs
Builds both static (.a) and self-contained shared (.so) libraries. The shared library has no runtime dependencies on ROS shared libraries.
